name: Career and College Promise (dual enrollment at Durham Tech)
what_you_do: Take college classes for free while in high school and earn both high school and college credit. Pick a college transfer path or a career and technical path (a certificate or diploma).
who_can_apply: High school juniors and seniors in North Carolina. Need a 2.8 or higher unweighted GPA, or test scores showing college readiness. The career path also accepts a written recommendation from your principal. To stay in, you must keep at least a 2.0 college GPA after two college courses.
deadline_text: Spring 2027: application opened Sept 11 and closes Nov 9 (2026). Paperwork due Nov 23. Last day to register Dec 1. Spring semester starts Jan 11, 2027.
how_to_apply: Go to an interest meeting. Talk to your school counselor and the Durham Tech liaison. Then send the CCP application and papers. These are the waiver and pathway forms, test scores and transcript.
notes: Students at Middle College High School, City of Medicine Academy and Durham School of Technology use a different path and deadline.
